proposed_decision.rule: Recognize [PERSON_REFERENT] [ZAMI] [LANGUAGE_CONTENT] as a governed linear frame for the recovered/approved language-use microdomain. S-P-O may be used only as an analytical compatibility label for this frame; do not declare a universal HNK basic word order.
proposed_decision.rationale: PHR-002 and PHR-003 provide approximate semantic support, while PHR-007 and PHR-006 repeat the same linear distribution without recoverable exact glosses. PHR-001 has a different structure. The evidence supports a local frame more strongly than a universal SVO grammar.

governance_decisions.proposal: Do not define AN/EN or other referents as universally obligatory grammatical subjects from this frame.
Do not define every post-ZAMI content expression as a universal grammatical object or create object case/marking.
Do not generalize ZAMI ordering to DAYI, SALI, VALI, PARAZAMI or other predicate classes without separate evidence.
Preserve B15: question-like uses may have final KE in their governed scope, but questions must not be generated from declarations merely by appending/removing KE.
B16 creates no universal SVO rule, movement rule, case system, tense/modal grammar, lexical authority changes, productivity changes or curriculum mappings.

approval_rule: A future SIGA may approve only DEC-B16-001 through DEC-B16-006 if this gate remains materially unchanged. The same SIGA must not approve B17, declare universal SVO, generalize ZAMI order to other predicates, or alter L03 curriculum.
